title: בשר בקר
description: Beef roasts and stews: printed clippings (pot roast, pomegranate and apple roast, wine and onion roast) and many handwritten cards from friends and relatives, some in very hard-to-read script. (Continuation cards merged into their recipes: scans -18 and -12 are further cards of the recipe b09-r13 (ids b09-r10 and b09-r14 unused).)
